summary: Iteration 25 — Frontend verification of Co-owner access + new 3-tier pricing. All requested UI flows pass end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Profile (/profile via profile-button): tier cards tier-monthly / tier-yearly / tier-lifetime render correct prices ('Monthly £19.99 per month', 'SAVE 17% Yearly £199 per year', 'BEST VALUE Lifetime £499 one-off'); default upgrade-pro-button reads 'Pay £199 · Yearly' (yearly is the default), selecting tier-lifetime switches to 'Pay £499 · Lifetime' and tier-monthly to 'Pay £19.99 · Monthly'. profile-link-co-owners navigates to co-owners-screen. Owner invite flow: co-owner-invite-button is correctly disabled (aria-disabled=true) when email is invalid ('notanemail'); after entering test_co_ui_83448@example.com and tapping Make co-owner, a co-owner-{id} card appeared under 'Your co-owners (1)' showing 'Invited · waiting for them to sign up' plus a Remove action (co-owner-remove-{id}). Co-owner journey: registered a fresh account with the invited email (name Test Coowner, Passw0rd1) via /auth, landed on home-screen; dashboard switch-project-button → projects-screen shows exactly one project-shared-badge-{id} with text 'Co-owner · Demo Builder' and NO project-delete-{id} on the shared row (verified via is_visible == False). Tapping project-row-{id} activated the shared project and returned to the dashboard, where co-owner-banner appears over the hero reading 'Co-owner · Demo Builder's project', project-name shows 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' and project-total-spent shows '£20,496 / £48,500' — demo's budget/data is correctly loaded. Profile shows co-owner-plan-note: 'You're working in Demo Builder's projects as a co-owner. Features there follow their plan (Basic). Your own billing is below.' Co-owners screen now shows a shared-owner-{owner_id} card 'Demo Builder · demo@mybuilder.app · 1 project · open them from My projects' with a Leave action (shared-leave-{id}); tapping Leave reveals shared-leave-confirm-{id} and tapping confirm removes the shared-owner card and triggers an auth refresh (co-owner-plan-note gone, 'Your co-owners (0) · Nobody yet.' now shown). The projects list after leave contains 0 project-shared-badge-* entries. All testIDs listed in the request were found and worked. Cleanup done: DELETE /api/auth/account with password 200 ok; subsequent login returns 401; demo's /co-owners is [] and active project is 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb'. No deprecated react-native packages touched in co-owners.tsx / profile.tsx / projects.tsx / (tabs)/index.tsx. One pre-existing non-blocking console warning observed app-wide (not introduced by this feature): 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — these come from library-level styles and the Switch wrapper; worth noting for a future cleanup but do not affect behaviour.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents` on <View> instead of style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/profile.tsx:171 (<View pointerEvents="none">...). Low priority — purely a console warning, no runtime impact in this feature.

action_items: (Optional nit) /app/frontend/app/profile.tsx:171 — swap <View pointerEvents="none"> for <View style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}> to silence RNW deprecation warning.

(Optional nit) RN Web shadow* props deprecation warning appears from a shared style (not from the files under review). If any newly-authored card style uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/..., migrate to boxShadow when convenient.
No functional action items from this iteration — co-owner access + 3-tier pricing UI are verified green and ready to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx:21-25 TIERS array hard-codes £19.99/£199/£499 and corresponding labels; upgrade-pro-button title correctly interpolates both the price and the TIERS[].label — no risk of mismatch.
profile.tsx:36 default tier state is 'yearly' which matches the 'SAVE 17%' highlighted card — good default for conversion.
profile.tsx:115-119 co-owner-plan-note gated on user.acting_as; text reads user.plan (effective plan, i.e. owner's plan) which matches spec — co-owners see owner's plan name.
co-owners.tsx:56 invite-button disabled check `/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.trim())` correctly rejects 'notanemail' and permits valid addresses (verified aria-disabled=true on invalid input).
co-owners.tsx:39-43 leave mutation invalidates ALL queries then refreshes auth so acting_as flips off and co-owner-banner/plan-note disappear without manual reload — confirmed live.
projects.tsx:85-91 shared pill only renders when p.shared is true; delete button block at :106 is gated by `!p.active && !p.shared` so shared projects never offer delete — matches spec.
(tabs)/index.tsx:104-109 co-owner-banner rendered only when user.acting_as present — correctly disappears after Leave once /auth/me is refreshed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Co-owner UX verified. Important selector notes for future runs: (a) After entering/leaving FormScreen modals (co-owners, profile), the underlying home-screen testID remains in the DOM but hidden; use data-testid state + screen check carefully — closing the FormScreen requires clicking its close button (ue405 X icon in header, no stable testID yet; worth adding a `form-close-button` testID). (b) Co-owner invite card testID is `co-owner-{id}` where id is a Mongo ObjectId; use CSS selector `[data-testid^="co-owner-"]` and filter out input/button/empty/remove-* variants when scanning. (c) The sharing demo project id changes per demo seed but there is always exactly 1 demo project named 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb'; expect project-total-spent around '£20,496 / £48,500'. (d) Login endpoint sometimes returns 502 for 1-2s on cold connects — add retries. (e) Deprecation console warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) are expected and NOT regressions.
